question: What is the meaning of composition in relation to raw material information?
description:
The percentage of which raw material the object consists of. 
This information is typically an integer value and is used to describe the material composition of an object. 
It is a key aspect of material criticality, as it can impact the object's properties and environmental impact. 
The composition information can be found in manufacturer information or Environmental Product Declarations. 
It is also relevant for sustainable construction, as it can help identify opportunities for recycling and reducing waste. 
The composition information is an important part of the material module in the ontology, as it allows for the representation of complex material properties. 
It is also related to the material key notion, which is a fundamental concept in the material properties ontology. 
The composition information is crucial for promoting transparency and sustainability in construction and product development. 
It is also used in the condition assessment and last update documentation, as it can help track changes in material composition over time. 
Overall, the composition information is a critical aspect of material information and plays a key role in sustainable construction and product development. 
The composition information is also related to the material criticality property, which indicates whether the material is hazardous or not.
